$Comment: The most any one damage type's summed percent bonus reaches for the carrier, in whole percent points (1000 is at most +1000%), counting the DamageBonus_<Type> stats and every other line a mod adds for that type or for every type. This file's Max is the ceiling every player starts with: a server retunes it by shipping a same-id file, and an item's StatModifiers raise or lower it for its wearer like any stat. It bounds each type on its own and leaves the game's own outgoing effects, such as Enrage, outside it.
